summary: Provisional campus-status concept: manually maintained hours/status with an expiry label; actual student pain and data ownership are unverified.
constraints: Synthetic scenario: two builders, 48 hours, zero paid API budget.

sources.reference: Authored fixture scenario; not an external source or real participant report.

claims.text: Synthetic scenario: two builders, 48 hours, zero paid API budget.
Students may not experience a consequential enough problem to use this.
claims.limitations: Not tested with real users or domain evidence.

decisions.text: Compare a status board with a FAQ bot. Prefer a manual status board for a small test; a bot adds retrieval uncertainty without evidence of need.

risks.description: Students may not experience a consequential enough problem to use this.
risks.test_or_mitigation: Observe or interview actual affected users; record real examples and reject the concept if status access is not a meaningful cause of wasted trips.

next_action.description: Interview or observe affected students with appropriate consent; determine whether avoidable trips occur and who owns status updates.
